summary: Everything one hit carries, so a Hurtbox understands one shape regardless of the attack type.
overview: The damage, the knockback and who did it. Shared by melee, hitscan and projectile attacks — which is what lets a target need only one receiving component.
useCases: Passing a hit through a chain of modifiers before it lands.
Reading who attacked, for kill attribution or aggro.
Adding a field once and having every attack type carry it.

gotchas.title: It is a struct, so it is copied
gotchas.body: Modifying one you received changes your copy, not the original. That is usually what you want, and surprising if you expected a reference.
